verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a CLI reference with example commands, REST-based Connect and Events APIs, SDKs, llms.txt and markdown mirrors, and a public docs MCP server. None of it documents an interactive API reference, such as a try-it console or explorer, where examples can be run in place. Static example commands and AI-readable docs are adjacent features, not the interactive, runnable reference this story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
